blockingIssues.description: The raw-path traversal fix only validates the first HTTP request on each TCP connection before converting the socket into an uninspected pipe, so a keep-alive or pipelined follow-up request can still deliver raw dot-segment traversal that Bun normalizes and routes without pre-routing rejection.

nonBlockingIssues.description: The new regressions exercise the raw-path validator directly but still do not cover the actual proxy transport or multi-request connection reuse, which is how the one-request-only blind spot shipped.

appliedUpdates.description: Added `linear_broker_env_status` to `.factory/services.yaml` so reruns have a named env-backed broker-auth Linear smoke instead of ad-hoc inline commands when proving keychainless broker seeding.

Updated `.factory/library/environment.md` to document env-backed Hack auth session variables for deterministic broker-auth verification and the broker-down outage-proof recipe using `HACK_AUTH_BROKER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9` with `HACK_SETUP_SYNC_MODE=off`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document isolated temp-HOME foreground-daemon smoke validation as an allowed pattern for daemon-socket hardening so workers can verify raw request-target behavior without mutating shared daemon state.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `daemon-raw-path-traversal-rejection-fix` worker had to deviate from the stated runtime procedure and use an isolated temp-HOME `bun index.ts daemon start --foreground` smoke to verify daemon request-target handling safely.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require `agent-browser` proof or an explicit recorded deviation whenever control-plane workers change rendered web UI, even if the primary code lives outside `apps/web`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both `mission-linear-closeout-audit` and `linear-closeout-evidence-artifact-anchor-fix` changed visible Linear management UI without any `agent-browser` run or justified deviation, despite mission guidance requiring browser validation for user-facing web behavior.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a reusable routed validation command for fixture-backed env-management browser states immediately.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected for now because the current gap is runtime/fixture orchestration, not a missing additive shell alias in `.factory/services.yaml`; a correct fix needs deliberate routed test-state setup rather than another ad-hoc command.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a single shared outage-mode command that covers every CLI optionality case.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected for now because the reviewed outage proof still depends on repo-specific setup and multi-step session lifecycle state; encoding it as one global command would be brittle without a clearer reusable harness.
